page_title: ACM 0-0 JUV | AC Milan v Juventus 26/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
90+3' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is adjudged offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) coming on for Jonathan David.
86' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
85' Jonathan David (Juventus) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
85' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
84' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
83' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simone Sozza signals.
83' It looks like Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
82' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
82' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
81' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Francisco Conceicao walks off the pitch to be replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
80' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) replacing Jeremie Boga.
80' A substitution has been made. Rafael Leao is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
80' The medical team appears concerned about a possible head injury to Luka Modric. He’ll take no further part in the game and Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) replaces him.
76' Looks like Luka Modric (AC Milan) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
76' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' The free kick is taken by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), but ball is cleared.
75' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
74' A snap shot by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan produces a good save to thwart him.
73' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
72' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Khephren Thuram is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).
71' Substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Emil Holm (Juventus).
69' A pass from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio and the move breaks down.
68' A lofted cross from Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
67' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
67' Youssouf Fofana goes off the pitch and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) comes on.
66' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) picks up an injury.
64' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

63' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
62' Substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.

61' Pierre Kalulu sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Jonathan David (Juventus), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post.
60' Rafael Leao finds Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
59' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
57' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece.
57' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
56' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Juventus will take a corner kick.
55' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
53' Bremer (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mike Maignan sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.

50' OFF THE BAR! Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
49' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Good movement by Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
46' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Half-time substitution. Massimiliano Allegri decided to make a change. Davide Bartesaghi is replaced by Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan).
46' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Mike Maignan inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Simone Sozza blows his whistle after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
42' Luka Modric (AC Milan) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.

40' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Mike Maignan, who tips the ball around the post.
39' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off the line to clear the ball away.
38' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
37' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
37' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Juventus players aren’t happy.
36' Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Francisco Conceicao finds Khephren Thuram (Juventus) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
35' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
35' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Michele Di Gregorio easily deals with the threat.
34' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
33' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
32' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Weston McKennie (Juventus) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
28' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
28' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.
26' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) works the corner short.
25' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
23' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
20' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
19' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
16' Weston McKennie (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
11' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half has just begun.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
